description: This file defines the GoCardlessSettings class for managing GoCardless payment gateway integration in a Frappe/ERPNext application, including client initialization, payment request handling, and mandate validation.

classes.name: GoCardlessSettings
classes.description: A class for configuring and handling GoCardless payment gateway settings and transactions within ERPNext.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the settings, primarily initializing the client.

methods.name: initialize_client
methods.description: Initializes the GoCardless client based on environment and access token.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when settings are updated, such as creating payment gateway and calling hooks.

methods.name: on_payment_request_submission
methods.description: Prepares and validates data for a payment request submission, including mandate validation.

methods.name: check_mandate_validity
methods.description: Checks if a valid mandate exists for the customer.

methods.name: get_payment_url
methods.description: Generates a URL for the GoCardless checkout.

methods.name: create_payment_request
methods.description: Creates a payment request and logs the request.

methods.name: create_charge_on_gocardless
methods.description: Creates a charge on GoCardless and handles response statuses, redirects, and error logging.
